serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Mendix Cloud for Government offers a no-code and low-code development platform-as-a-service (PaaS) that allows accelerated development of software-as-a-service (SaaS)-based, enterprise-grade applications. This accelerated development allows for rapid application delivery across an entire application development lifecycle, from ideation to deployment and operations. 

The Mendix platform consists of a front-end development tool, Mendix Studio Pro, and back-end infrastructure to support the deployment of developed applications. Mendix enables customers to implement both Agile and DevOps best practices and involves business stakeholders closely in the development of applications to ensure suitability of the solution.
